exposure: history of corneal transplant in the fellow eye
cohort: The study included 201 eyes from 201 keratoconus patients without corneal neovascularization who underwent penetrating keratoplasty (PKP) between November 2014 and December 2016.
finding: While multivariable analysis found no significant association between donor-related factors and graft rejection, short death-to-surgery time, a history of PKP in the fellow eye, and postoperative corneal neovascularization were associated with an increased risk of rejection after PKP.
